notes.title: Political Economy Update: Factions, Riots, and Power
notes.notes: [p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3503190/AstroCore_Mining/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]With the new Political Economy Update, Astrocore Mining goes beyond survival and resource extraction. As a middle manager in charge of a corporate colony, you face faction conflicts, worker riots, and interstellar diplomacy. [/p][p][/p][p]Choose your ruling style such as democratic or authoritarian, and balance CEO pressure against worker survival. Every policy you enact, every quota you enforce, and every deal you strike determines whether your company rises as a capitalist powerhouse or collapses under chaos.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545968/01c17e82188f645421db72ba6db619e0c1eb8a03.png"][/img][/p][h3]✦ New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Main Frame Building[/b]: The central hub where managers oversee all asteroid operations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Manager Role[/b]: You control the fate of the colony, from strategy to survival.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Guards[/b]: Armed units defend against pirate raids. More guards can be recruited to secure the asteroid.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pirate Raids[/b]: Pirates attack, stealing funds and killing anyone in their way.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Air Lock Building[/b]: Entry point for all ships docking at the asteroid.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Worker Riots[/b]: Unpaid workers revolt, spreading chaos across the colony.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hospital Beds[/b]: Provide recovery areas where injured workers can heal.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545968/29063d3e7ffe04d1fd02430e0814bc4a83a2994d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Astrocore Mining is Now Open for Wishlists!
notes.notes:
Hello,

Our new game, AstroCore Mining, is now available for wishlist on Steam! This colony simulation sandbox game challenges players to manage a mining colony on asteroids, extract resources, and survive the harsh realities of deep-space capitalism. Build underground bases, defend against pirates, and push your workforce to the edge to meet corporate quotas, or face the consequences.


What Awaits Players in AstroCore Mining:

-Asteroid Colonization:  Tunnel through asteroids, build underground facilities, and optimize for efficiency.
-Dynamic Resource System: Extract rare minerals, refine resources, and maintain a steady supply chain.
-Survival & Population Management: Oxygen, food, morale, every detail matters.
-Asteroid Modification: Attach thrusters to asteroids and guide them to new systems.
-Hostile Encounters: Defend against pirate raids and corporate rivals in deep space.
-Corporate Quotas & Moral Dilemmas: Will you prioritize your workers’ well-being or push for maximum profit?

🔗 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3503190/AstroCore_Mining/
